ai_summary: Arman Financial Services Limited reported a strong Q1 FY27, achieving an all-time high Consolidated Assets Under Management of INR 2,925 Crore (35.7% YoY growth) and a significant turnaround to a Profit After Tax of INR 45 Crore, compared to a loss in the prior-year quarter. This performance was driven by record disbursements, improved collection efficiency of 96.6%, and better asset quality with GNPA and NNPA at 2.76% and 0.84% respectively, supported by lower provisioning. While current results are robust, management remains watchful of potential future impacts from global macroeconomic headwinds, which could affect repayment behavior in coming quarters.
